sloka: प्रयच्छ नो हि लोकेश पार्थिवं नरपुङ्गवम् ।यस्मै पूजां प्रयुञ्जाना धूतपापाश्चरेमहि ।न वसामो विना राज्ञा एष नो निश्चयः परः ।। ७.७६.३९ ॥
transliteration: prayaccha no hi lokeśa pārthivaṁ narapuṅgavam ।yasmai pūjāṁ prayuñjānā dhūtapāpāścaremahi ।na vasāmo vinā rājñā eṣa no niścayaḥ paraḥ ।। 7.76.39 ॥

translations.english: The people implored Brahma, the Lord of the worlds, to grant them an earthly king, a best among men, whom they could worship to cleanse their sins and under whose rule they could live, as they declared their supreme resolve not to live without a king.
